primary_question: Do the already-frozen Position Weight V2, Replacement Level V2, and Production V2 studies explain the current cross-position apex concern through distinct evidence, or do their effects overlap enough that stacking them would risk double counting and overcorrection?
rules: do not fit or optimize any coefficient
do not select a Production V2 arm because of Week 1 results
preserve every upstream frozen candidate artifact byte-for-byte
use Position Weight V2 bridge_50 only because it was the sole preseason-frozen noncontrol arm
use Replacement Level V2 stable_positions_only as the pre-frozen stability-restricted structural sensitivity arm while still reporting all four replacement families
for Production V2, report the frozen history-weight 0.25, 0.45, and 0.65 sensitivity arms at fixed fp=0.50, evidence_hybrid ranks, and floor=0.15; do not label any one of them a winner
never treat Week 1 collection-only evidence as deployment-grade evidence
never force Brian Burns below Josh Allen as an objective

source-state drift between preseason freezes and the current live board
